methodology.interactionProtocol: capture-started browser readiness promise; action-specific precondition and committed DOM postcondition; three unchanged frames after the first committed frame; Playwright trigger completion separate
methodology.cold: Fresh browser context and page per sample; browser process reused, OS and server caches uncontrolled
methodology.warm: Same context, one discarded warmup, fresh page per measured sample
methodology.usable: Fonts ready; loaded counts, SVG geometry and hit targets valid; transform/dimensions/counts stable for three consecutive animation frames
methodology.network: Local prebuilt production bundle only; no Splunk dispatch or result download
methodology.thresholds: None; measured baseline precedes provisional engineering budgets
methodology.environment: Local developer machine; concurrent background activity possible; no CPU/network throttling
